author: Brett Willis
text: I called Chambliss at 7:45 on Monday morning to ask about septic tank pumping. The gentleman was very friendly and quoted me a price, letting me know it could go above that if they ran into unforeseen problems. One hour later they were at my house. They pumped the tank out, honored the price quoted on the phone, and replaced the dirt and sod neatly. I couldn't have asked for better service and will be using them for all future septic needs.

author: Emmanuel Cabrera
text: This company was great. Very professional and it was a pleasure doing business with them. On time and very thorough. I will be using them next time and will be letting my neighbors know about them. Thank you again guys.

author: Shirlene Dickerson
text:
Thank you Tommy and Michael and there was another young man that helped open and pump our tank after we spent a weekend with a backed up system.  They took the time to listen to our concerns and make suggestions for alternatives if needed in the future.
Very kind and knowledgeable.
Michael  came back out the next day to install risers and we received the same efficient service.
We highly recommend Chambliss Const. for any of your septic needs.

author: Juanita Knighton
text: Needed our septic tank pumped out, contacted Chambliss received a call back within a couple of hours and was given appointment 2 days after. They arrived earlier than told, were very professional, knowledgeable and answered addressed all concerns. They made sure the area was left in excellent condition when they left. HIGHLY recommend them for your septic needs.

author: Brenda Theus
text: Chambliss has provided us with excellent septic service for many years. They go the extra mile with helping us out and giving good advice.
